title: Wagner Marches on Moscow, Then Turns Back
dek: Yevgeny Prigozhin's mercenaries take Rostov-on-Don and drive north for a day before a deal brokered by Alexander Lukashenko halts them.
body: Prigozhin said his men came within 200 km of Moscow. Two months later his jet crashed, killing all 10 aboard.

panels.label: Putin Says
panels.text: Putin calls the mutiny “a knife in the back” of Russia and “treason” born of “inflated ambitions.”

panels.label: Prigozhin Said
panels.text: Prigozhin called it “a march of justice” and turned back so no “Russian blood” would be spilled.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side calls it treason, the other justice; at stake is whether anyone but the Kremlin may command armed men in Russia.
